ABOUT THE RECORD

A living gear list.

This collection brings together the original hiking inventory, tax invoices and purchase screenshots. Invoice prices use the tax-inclusive line amounts in Australian dollars. Screenshot purchases stay in Chinese yuan; currencies are never converted or compared. Weights are listed or approximate values and may change after an item is weighed at home.

Product photos show the listed models; colors or revisions may differ from the items owned. Items with missing details stay visible so the record can be completed over time. Older and lost gear is identified separately from the current kit. A receipt records a purchase, not whether a consumable is still in the pack.
